validation_controller.source: read-only controller readings stored in robot_agent/runs (FR3 V6.0, controller V3.8.25-QX)
validation_controller.conclusion: The controller's reported flange pose equals the vendor-URDF wrist3 frame shifted by ~100 mm along its z axis. This validates the NOMINAL model the controller uses; it says nothing about the robot's true (absolute) accuracy, which needs an external reference.
